_comment: Ground truth for search-quality evaluation, labelled by hand against this repository.
The unit is a FILE, not a symbol name: file paths survive renames of the items inside
them and can be re-verified by reading the repo (see tests/relevance_dataset.rs, which
fails if a labelled path no longer exists).
Queries are in English on purpose — both bge profiles are `bge-small-EN-v1.5`, so a
Russian query would measure the tokenizer's helplessness rather than the profile.
Labels name where the capability LIVES (its implementation), not every file mentioning it.

cases.query: detect which files changed since the last indexing run
cases.rationale: Merkle-tree change detection and the incremental indexer that drives it.

cases.query: store embedding vectors and find nearest neighbours
cases.rationale: LanceDB backend plus the VectorStore facade with its search method.

cases.query: combine keyword ranking and semantic ranking into one result list
cases.rationale: HybridSearch and reciprocal rank fusion live here.

cases.query: keyword search over code with tantivy
cases.rationale: Bm25Search queries the tantivy index the adapter writes.

cases.query: split a source file into semantic pieces for embedding
cases.rationale: The chunker engine and the oversized-chunk splitter.

cases.query: count tokens and cut an input that is too long for the model
cases.rationale: Token-length measurement and the token-based split path.

cases.query: which embedding model to load and what dimension it produces
cases.rationale: Built-in profile table and the TOML/env registry that resolves a name to it.

cases.query: run the embedding model on an AMD graphics card
cases.rationale: The ONNX path with the MIGraphX execution provider and its kernel cache.

cases.query: prove the graph really ran on the GPU instead of silently falling back to CPU
cases.rationale: ProviderCensus counts nodes per execution provider from an ORT profile.

cases.query: retry an HTTP request after rate limiting with backoff
cases.rationale: Retry classification and backoff for OpenRouter calls.

cases.query: group inputs into batches before sending them to the embedding API
cases.rationale: API-side batch planning and the memory-aware batcher on the indexing side.

cases.query: read the API key from an environment variable
cases.rationale: API_KEY_ENV / FALLBACK_API_KEY_ENV and the rest of the env parsing.

cases.query: parse rust source into a syntax tree
cases.rationale: RustParser over ra_ap_syntax and the module that exposes it.

cases.query: extract use statements and imports from a file
cases.rationale: Import extraction pass.

cases.query: build a call graph of which function calls which
cases.rationale: Syntactic call-graph construction and the persisted-graph calls query family.

cases.query: find every place a type is used
cases.rationale: Type-reference tracking and the usage extraction pass.

cases.query: persist the workspace graph snapshot on disk
cases.rationale: heed storage layout and the staging/write/publish lifecycle.

cases.query: report public items that nothing outside the crate uses
cases.rationale: dead_pub_in_crate / dead_pub_report queries and their MCP endpoints.

cases.query: audit unsafe blocks in the workspace
cases.rationale: The unsafe-block audit pass.

cases.query: detect recursive functions
cases.rationale: recursion_check pass.

cases.query: which derive macros are attached to structs and enums
cases.rationale: derive_audit pass.

cases.query: check the capacity given to channels
cases.rationale: channel_capacity_audit pass.

cases.query: render a mermaid diagram of the module structure
cases.rationale: Mermaid and outline renderers for the codemap.

cases.query: produce a skeleton of a crate with signatures but no bodies
cases.rationale: Skeleton collection and rendering; the endpoint wrapper lives elsewhere.

cases.query: reindex automatically in the background when files change
cases.rationale: Background sync manager.

cases.query: prevent two operations from indexing the same workspace at once
cases.rationale: Per-workspace operation locks.

cases.query: dispatch an incoming MCP tool call to its handler
cases.rationale: The tool router.

cases.query: rename a symbol across the project using rust-analyzer
cases.rationale: Rename via rust-analyzer.

cases.query: convert a line and column into a byte offset
cases.rationale: Position and coordinate utilities.

cases.query: report whether the index is healthy
cases.rationale: Health monitor and the MCP endpoint exposing it.

cases.query: skip files containing passwords or secret keys
cases.rationale: The security module that filters files out of indexing. NOT secrets.rs: the scanner's own pattern table trips it, so the indexer excludes that file from the corpus and no profile can ever retrieve it.

cases.query: decide which rust files belong to the project and which directories to skip
cases.rationale: collect_project_rust_files and is_skipped_dir_name — the single source of truth.

cases.query: where cache and index artifacts for a project are placed on disk
cases.rationale: Artifact path derivation on the indexing side and its server-side counterpart.

cases.query: clear a corrupted metadata cache
cases.rationale: The clear-cache endpoint and the cache it clears.

cases.query: measure how much memory indexing is using
cases.rationale: Memory usage monitoring.

cases.query: back up and restore the merkle snapshot
cases.rationale: Backup and restore for merkle snapshots.
